attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation does not cover arbitrary semantic SAT branch pruning or FormulaEval rules whose influencing rows are not determined by proof syntax before use; this is exactly RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^{arb}.
steps: Define K_Qrep^t by prefix recursion: start with bEF, SR_h, FormulaEval, and CTSR visible supports; when a Qrep dictionary entry e appears, add its row endpoints and certificate footprint only if every dependency is already in K_Qrep^{<t} and every rank decreases.
For non-Qrep lines, reuse the existing Gamma_bEF/Gamma_dag/CTSR line-induction invariant: each parsed proof dependency either contributes a charged row or is already in the support cone.

For a Qrep use at line t, replace the quotient representative by the row rep_e plus the strict-prefix same-theory certificate forest sigma_e. Since sigma_e is already charged, the replay adds no post-hoc support and preserves the carrier row semantics used by the parser.

Compose all replays in line order. Rank decrease and prefix ordering prevent cycles and representative rebinding, so the expanded proof has the same final LB_N line and total support bounded by Gamma_Qrep.

Build the nonuniform circuit for H_N from the generator circuit, parsed row computations, charged FormulaEval/TSR/Qrep support, and equality patches for E_pi residual rows, obtaining C(H_N)<=N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_Qrep+O(E_pi N).
Contrapose the claimed source lower bound LB_N(1+epsilon): if the displayed upper bound is below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, the claimed proof-mediated lower-bound certificate is falsified in the same model.

For necessity, choose the first unsafe quotient use. Keep the visible prefix fixed, toggle an uncharged private row or unread enable bit that controls same-theory status, and obtain two worlds with identical accepted prefix but different uncovered parity or certificate truth.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a scoped parser/falsifier theorem for proof transcripts around a beta-zero parity carrier. It proves neither LB_N for H_N nor P != NP, and it does not claim full semantic EF+SAT extraction.

assumptions: Length regime: N grows through valid carrier lengths; M_N=N^{q+o(1)} with q<1+epsilon; generator overhead is N^{rho+o(1)} with rho<1+epsilon.
Proof-system regime: pi is a finite Psys_sym^{Qrep} transcript whose Qrep entry e=(r_e,rep_e,sigma_e,rank_e,t_e) is syntactically declared at line t_e before any line using rep_e for r_e.
Uniformity/advice regime: K_Qrep(pi) and every same-theory certificate forest are computable from N and pi; no SAT-truth advice, hidden selector advice, or post-use rebinding is allowed.

Barrier status: the lemma is syntactic and label-relativizing; it deliberately does not realize full real-SAT semantic pruning. The nonrelativizing RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^{arb} remains outside the claim.
definitions: source object: beta-zero parity carrier H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, polylog formula length, generator size N^{rho+o(1)}, and proof transcript pi in Psys_sym^{Qrep}.
target object: same-model nonuniform SIZE upper-bound falsifier for LB_N(1+epsilon) obtained from a charged proof parser, not a proof of H_N lower bounds or P != NP.

controlled interface: TransparentRowSupport_N with bit-explicit bEF lines, bounded SR_h rows, FormulaEval support cone K, counterfactual TSR rows, and ranked proof-carrying Qrep dictionary entries charged before representative use.

target-preserving condition: the replay must preserve the carrier rows, the nonuniform SIZE model, q,rho,epsilon thresholds, advice-freeness of row selection, and same-theory SAT equivalence certificates before any quotient use.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A falsifier occurs if any representative is used before its same-theory certificate is charged, if ranks are cyclic, if the dictionary is advice-chosen, or if a hidden semantic merge changes an uncharged carrier row.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Positive replay lemma closing the temporal Qrep loophole inside TransparentRowSupport_N and producing a live inference-quality source-to-target packet.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Strict-prefix ranked Qrep quotient compression is a valid TransparentRowSupport_N rule case: every quotient representative used in a proof line can be replayed to an explicit same-theory row plus a previously charged certificate forest, so Gamma_Qrep supports the same parser-to-circuit falsifier as the uncompressed transparent proof.

assumptions: The proof verifier before the unsafe line reads only visible prefix data and charged dictionary entries.
There exists at least one reachable carrier row whose same-theory status is neither syntactically certified nor included in K_Qrep before use.
The model permits nonuniform circuits to hardwire visible transcript data but not to infer hidden SAT semantics without a charged realizer.
definitions: source object: a Psys_sym proof prefix containing a quotient use of row r through representative rep before any charged same-theory proof of r~rep appears.
target object: private-row or unread-enable-bit countermodel refuting free quotient compression as transparent support.
controlled interface: visible prefix transcript, row labels, Qrep dictionary, and same-theory certificates available before the quotient use.

target-preserving condition: the two-world construction preserves all charged rows, generator syntax, proof prefix bits, and q,rho,epsilon parameters while varying only the uncharged row or enable bit.

equations.label: two_world_agreement
equations.valid_when: Valid when the unsafe quotient line has not charged r star or a same-theory certificate before the prefix t.

equations.label: parity_flip_condition
equations.latex: H_N^{(0)}(x)\oplus H_N^{(1)}(x)=1\quad \text{if } r^* \text{ has odd uncovered incidence}.
equations.valid_when: Applies when the private row participates with odd parity in the beta-zero XOR carrier after visible rows are fixed.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: The no-go fails only if a nonrelativizing RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N uniformly lists and charges r^* before the unsafe use.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Necessity theorem for strict-prefix Qrep; supplies the exact falsifier against temporal hidden support.
candidate_lemmas.statement: If Qrep compression permits delayed, cyclic, advice-chosen, or hidden semantic merges, extensional safety fails: two transcripts agree on all visible prefix data while an uncharged private row changes the quotient representative and can flip the parity carrier or the parsed LB_N certificate.

assumptions: All row identifiers have O(log N+polylog N) bit encodings and all certificate parent pointers are explicit.
Ranks are natural numbers of polynomially bounded bit length or are checked by a well-founded lexicographic measure.
Rejected entries are not silently ignored; the first rejected merge is exported as the countermodel pivot.
definitions: source object: finite proof transcript pi with line numbers, row identifiers, representative identifiers, certificate hashes, parent pointers, and ranks.
target object: implementable verifier for the Qrep clause of TransparentRowSupport_N.
controlled interface: prefix scan, append-only dictionary, rank-decreasing certificate forest, and dependency-closed K_Qrep update rule.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A counterexample is a valid-looking proof whose accepted representatives depend on a later certificate, a rebinding, or an unranked semantic equality.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Proof-quality upgrade: turns the Qrep rule case into a referee-checkable finite interface rather than an informal convention.
candidate_lemmas.statement: The strict-prefix Qrep condition is finitely auditable: scanning pi in line order while maintaining K_Qrep, dictionary entries, certificate dependencies, and decreasing ranks decides whether every quotient use is transparent before the parser line induction starts.

falsifiers: First late Qrep merge: representative used before its same-theory certificate is charged, producing a private-row falsifier.
Rank cycle or representative rebinding: replay is not well-founded, so Gamma reduction is invalid.
Advice-chosen dictionary: K_Qrep is not determined by N and pi, causing nonuniform leakage.
Hidden semantic pruning: the proof uses real SAT structure without listing influencing rows, blocked at RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^{arb}.
Positive beta black-box substitution remains a separate threshold-collapse falsifier: q+beta c can exceed 1+epsilon before all SAT exponents are excluded.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For Delta=0 with strict-prefix charging, replay preserves Gamma_Qrep and the parser upper bound is valid. For any Delta>0 at the first use, a private-row or unread-enable-bit world can agree on the visible prefix while changing the uncharged merge, so free compression is invalid.
held_fixed_controls: M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, rho<1+epsilon, and polylog SAT formula length are fixed.
The visible proof prefix, generator G_N, charged bEF/SR_h/FormulaEval/CTSR supports, and nonuniform SIZE model are fixed.
No SAT-truth advice or advice-chosen row selector is allowed.
The final LB_N(1+epsilon) assertion and residual patch budget E_pi are fixed.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch is no longer testing a broad magnification slogan; it must decide whether temporal quotient compression is a valid transparent support rule or a hidden-support leak.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A beta-zero XOR carrier with M_N=N^{q+o(1)} generated SAT rows and a Psys_sym proof whose CTSR frontier creates two syntactically different but same-theory child rows r0,r1; Qrep may merge r1 into representative r0.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A strict-prefix RealSATInfluence certificate: before representative use, proof syntax must uniformly list the merged rows, a same-theory certificate forest, rank-decreasing dependencies, and the exact Gamma charge.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: certificate delay Delta, the number of proof lines between first representative use and the line where the same-theory certificate for r1~r0 is surfaced and charged.
